item.title: Android malware alert: Fake IPTV apps will steal your bank details
item.description: A new Android malware called “Massiv” is on the rise. Security researchers at ThreatFabric uncovered the large-scale campaign, in which hackers disguised and distributed the malware as a harmless IPTV streaming app. Once installed, however, the app was able to read screen inputs to steal passwords and bank details. item.title: Microsoft Edge starts phasing out key password manager feature
item.description: The latest update to Microsoft Edge has changed how the browser’s password manager works, reports Neowin. On Friday, Microsoft rolled out a new update to Edge version 145, removing support for master passwords for the browser’s password manager. It will no longer be possible to create a new master password to access the password manager in Edge.
